description.$comment: A description list (1.10, 0110): rows of a term and its value, a line between them and none under the last. The term is the muted text and the value the full one, because the value is what the row is read for; the term's width is a basis rather than a column, so the rows line up while they hold it and a value wraps under its term when they do not.

border.$description: Colour of the line between rows.

gap.$description: Gap between the term, the value and the control of a row.

term-width.$description: Width of a term while the row holds it.

min-width.$description: The narrowest a value stands beside its term before it wraps under it.
